author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, samples, availability, and confirmation work is original and human-made (no generative AI).
